title: Week 33 Module Intro
description_html: Before you open this week's lessons, read the Module Map, then answer these two questions. This survey is not graded, and a guess is fine. Your teacher reads the answers to see what the class already thinks.

questions.name: Essential question
questions.text_html: This week's essential question is: Why did Texas grow so quickly after the war, and how did it come to look so much like the rest of the nation? Write two or three sentences with your best first answer, even if it is a guess.

questions.name: Module Map
questions.text_html: Have you read this week's Module Map, and do you know what you need to turn in?
